indicators.title: Economic Indicators
indicators.cdiBasis: Estimate based on SELIC minus 0.10 percentage points.
indicators.howItAffects: How does this affect your finances?
indicators.selicExplanation: It is Brazil's base interest rate. When it rises, loans tend to become more expensive, while fixed-income investments may yield more. It directly affects credit and consumption.
indicators.ipcaExplanation: It measures changes in the prices of products and services. The higher the IPCA, the lower purchasing power tends to be. It is a reference for salary adjustments and contracts.
indicators.cdiExplanation: It is a rate used between banks and a reference for fixed-income investments. It generally stays close to SELIC; many funds and CDBs use CDI as a reference.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This page explains, in clear language, how JulisHub handles information when you browse the platform.

currentScope.title: Current scope:
currentScope.description: Today, JulisHub uses browser storage to remember language and theme preferences, uses analytics tools to measure stability and navigation, and queries third-party APIs to display market data. If new features such as saved watchlists, notifications, authentication, or additional measurement integrations are enabled, this policy will be updated before the scope of processing expands, including details about data categories, purposes, retention, and applicable controls.

intro.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: JulisHub is a platform focused on financial information, indicators, calculators, and educational content. Our goal is to provide a useful and transparent experience while collecting as little personal data as possible to operate the service.

Privacy is part of product quality. For that reason, we explain objectively which data may be processed, why that happens, and which choices you have as a data subject, in line with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).

automaticData.heading: Automatically Collected Data
paragraphs: When you access JulisHub, some technical data may be processed automatically to load the application, protect the infrastructure, adapt the interface to your device, and measure service performance.

At the moment, JulisHub does not require account creation for regular browsing and does not rely on sensitive personal data to deliver its main features. Even so, infrastructure services, analytics tools, and browser resources may record operational information such as the items below.

Not all browser-side storage serves the same purpose. Essential preferences, such as language and theme, may be stored locally to support basic personalization and continuity of use, while optional analytics tools are only activated when the user chooses to allow that processing.

Analytics tools may collect navigation events, visited pages, interactions, traffic source, aggregated device information, and performance indicators for continuous improvement, stability, usage analysis, and product decision-making.

Non-essential cookies and similar technologies, including those related to Google Analytics (GA4) and optional analytics measurements, are only activated after your explicit consent through the Cookie Banner. Without that consent, only resources strictly necessary for the site's operation remain active.
items: IP address and basic connection metadata, usually handled by hosting, security, and content delivery services.
Browser type and version, operating system, preferred language, and technical device characteristics used for compatibility and diagnostics.
Anonymized performance, availability, and stability measurements generated by Vercel Web Analytics, when authorized by the user, for technical monitoring of the application.
Navigation events and metrics processed by Google Analytics (GA4), when authorized by the user, to understand traffic, usage behavior, and browsing journeys.
Strictly technical cookies when needed for security, stability, or essential service operation, and non-essential cookies only after explicit consent.
Data stored in LocalStorage and SessionStorage to remember essential preferences such as language and visual theme, without use for advertising profiling.

thirdParty.heading: Use of APIs and Third-Party Services
paragraphs: To display quotes, indices, and other market data, JulisHub queries external APIs and providers. In that flow, some connection metadata may be processed by those third parties according to the infrastructure involved and their own privacy policies.

In addition to those integrations, JulisHub may use Vercel Web Analytics to monitor performance and stability with a technical focus and anonymized indicators, as well as Google Analytics (GA4) to understand navigation patterns, traffic acquisition, and page usage, always according to the choice recorded in the consent banner.

JulisHub uses responses from these APIs and services to present financial information, monitor application health, and guide product improvements, but it does not fully control the availability, retention, security, or processing practices adopted by each external provider.

When a service depends on non-essential cookies or identifiers, as is the case with Google Analytics (GA4) and the optional analytics measurements adopted by JulisHub, the related collection only takes place after the user's explicit consent through the Cookie Banner. We also recommend reviewing the privacy policies of the third-party providers applicable to each integration.

protection.heading: How We Protect Data
paragraphs: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to reduce risk, such as using HTTPS connections, limiting unnecessary information exposure, and reviewing the integrations used by the application.

We also seek to follow the minimization principle: processing only what is necessary for the feature being offered. Even so, no internet-connected environment is entirely risk-free, so monitoring, updates, and adjustments may be carried out continuously.

If future features require accounts, a database, persisted watchlists, or notifications, JulisHub should apply controls compatible with that new processing level, such as access management, permission segregation, operation logs, and retention criteria aligned with the service purpose.

rights.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: Under the LGPD, you may request information about the processing of your personal data whenever applicable. That includes requests related to the use, correction, or deletion of data maintained by the service.
We will review requests reasonably, considering legal obligations, technical limitations, and the nature of the data actually processed by JulisHub in each feature.
items: Confirm whether personal data processing exists and request access to the personal data related to you, when available.
Request correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary, excessive, or unlawfully processed data, when applicable.
Obtain information about sharing with third parties and the legal bases that justify processing.
Withdraw consent or object to processing in cases where the law allows that path.

changesContact.heading: Policy Changes and Contact
paragraphs: This policy may be updated to reflect legal, technical, or product changes. When that happens, we will publish the new version on this page with the corresponding revision date.
If a change materially affects how personal data is processed, JulisHub will seek to provide additional transparency before that change is put into practice.

The future rollout of features such as authentication, persisted watchlists, notifications, and new database integrations may require supplementary notices, adjustments to the consent banner, and updates to this policy so it reflects the actual data flow.

For questions, requests, or the exercise of rights, please use the official contact channels disclosed on JulisHub. If a dedicated privacy contact is created in the future, it will be published on this page.
